# OSHA Electrical Safety Training (NFPA 70E 2027)

> 3-hour online electrical safety course based on OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Subpart K (construction), 29 CFR 1910 Subpart S (general industry) and the 2027 edition of NFPA 70E. Available in English and Spanish. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Duration: 3 hours; 2 modules, 7 lessons with quizzes, final exam
- Credits: 0.3 CEU
- Price: $59.99 per person; bulk pricing available
- Delivery: 100% online, mobile-friendly, 24/7; SCORM, virtual and in-person classroom formats also available
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Certificate: downloadable on passing; valid 3 years
- OSHA standards are the law (performance-based); NFPA 70E is the consensus standard of prescriptive work practices OSHA looks to; following 70E is usually not itself legally required
- NFPA 70E: employers audit the electrical safety program at least every three years

## Lessons
Module 1: OSHA and the NFPA
1. What Is Electricity? (conductors, insulators, voltage, current, resistance, Ohm's law)
2. Electrical Hazards (shock vs. electrocution, falls, electrical fires)
3. Regulatory Overview (OSHA and NFPA requirements, electrical safety programs, 3-stage safety model)
Module 2: Hazard Controls and Safe Work Practices
4. Controlling Electrical Hazards (insulation, guarding, grounding, bonding, overcurrent protection, working space)
5. Electrically Safe Work Condition (lockout/tagout, circuits that cannot be de-energized)
6. Protective Equipment (PPE, arc-rated clothing, insulated tools, alerting techniques)
7. Safe Work Practices (wiring, overhead power line clearances, illumination, housekeeping, emergencies)

## Who should take it
Electricians and electrical engineers; maintenance, repair and HVAC technicians; construction workers; equipment operators; safety, facility and electrical program managers; electrical inspectors; janitorial staff near exposed equipment.
